project_type: Python FastAPI API + Temporal worker + Next.js 16 dashboard in a monorepo
build_system: No build step for Python; dashboard uses Next.js 16 (app router, no pages/). Alembic manages DB schema from repo root via alembic.ini pointing to packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/
test_framework: No test suite found (no pytest.ini, no jest.config). Verification is done via import checks and alembic upgrade head.
build_command: cd dashboard && npx next build  (dashboard only)
test_command: python -c 'from src.main import app' (API import check); python -c 'from flows.workflows import MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow' from worker/src/ (worker import check); cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit (TS type check)
verification_instructions: 1. From repo root: DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./test.db alembic upgrade head — must exit 0. 2. From api/: python -c 'from src.main import app; print([r.path for r in app.routes])' — must list /api/v1/runs. 3. From worker/src/: python -c 'from flows.workflows import MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow, HumanApprovalSignal' — no ImportError. 4. From dashboard/: npx tsc --noEmit — exit 0.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dashboard/.next/ (generated by next build, not committed). Alembic versions are committed.
environment_constraints: Do NOT restart or call the live dev server. Do NOT push to git. Alembic script_location is packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic (set in alembic.ini at repo root). The worker imports from services.*, agents.*, flows.* (relative to worker/src/). The API imports from src.* (relative to api/). synthetiq_shared is an installed package at packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/. Both API and worker share it. WorkflowRun ORM is in packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/organization.py (not a separate file). Alembic env.py imports synthetiq_shared.models which re-exports from models subpackage — all new ORM models must be imported in models/__init__.py to be picked up by autogenerate. Next.js version is 16.3.7 — read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before touching dashboard code.
contribution_requirements: dashboard/AGENTS.md: read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any dashboard code — Next.js 16 has breaking changes. Do not acknowledge this rule in responses.
key_patterns: 1. Route files import TenantCtx via 'from src.utils.tenant import TenantCtx, get_tenant_ctx'. 2. All DB writes go through 'async with get_db_session() as session: session.add(...)'. 3. Temporal dispatch via singleton: 'from src.services.temporal_service import temporal_service; await temporal_service.start_workflow(...)'. 4. RBAC via: '_: Any = Depends(require_permission("workflows:execute"))'. 5. Worker activities use 'from temporalio import activity; @activity.defn'. 6. Workflow signals use '@workflow.signal' decorator. 7. Alembic migrations follow pattern in a3f9c8e1d42b: create table with if_not_exists=True, add columns, FK, index, RLS (Postgres-only). 8. ORM models all live in organization.py and are exported from models/__init__.py. 9. Dashboard service calls go through BaseService.request() in app/lib/services/base.service.ts. 10. No APScheduler in worker — APScheduler is only in api/src/services/scheduler_service.py and api/src/main.py lifespan.
directory_structure: SynthetIQ/ root: alembic.ini (points to packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic), api/ (FastAPI app, entrypoint api/src/main.py, routes at api/src/routes/), worker/ (Temporal worker, entrypoint worker/src/main.py, flows at worker/src/flows/, activities at worker/src/activities/, services at worker/src/services/), packages/synthetiq-shared/ (shared Python package: models at synthetiq_shared/models/, constants at synthetiq_shared/constants/, utils at synthetiq_shared/utils/, alembic migrations at alembic/versions/), dashboard/ (Next.js 16 app, app router at dashboard/app/, services at dashboard/app/lib/services/, types at dashboard/app/lib/types/), .agents/tasks/ (plan and FEAT artifacts)
